name: litany
description: Unofficial Warhammer 40,000 fan skin for Claude Code, not affiliated with Games Workshop: themed spinner and turn line, Noosphere telemetry band and panel, Tech-Priest voice, warn-only heresy rites, synthesized sounds, spoken lore lines

spinner.title: Litany: spinner
spinner.description: Spinner phrases follow the active tool (Anointing the cogitator…)

hint.title: Litany: prompt hint
hint.description: A Universal Law, rotated each turn, at the end of the hint line

band.title: Litany: Noosphere band
band.description: Telemetry line above the prompt: context, tool calls, branch, cost, 5h window, heresies

voice.title: Litany: Tech-Priest voice
voice.description: Short +++ opener and closer on chat replies; never in code, commits or drafts

rites.title: Litany: heresy rites
rites.description: Warn (never block) on rm -rf, force-push, reset --hard and similar; note tool failures

sound.title: Litany: beeps
sound.description: Clips on the seven events: long turns, heresies, tool failures, permission waits, API errors, servitors waiting, auto-compaction

panel.title: Litany: NOOSPHERE panel
panel.description: Side panel with animated ASCII art, gauges and logs; docks itself on windows 144+ columns wide

pulse.title: Litany: panel pulse
pulse.description: The panel's braille graph of rites per minute

spirits.title: Litany: panel Machine spirits
spirits.description: The panel's tally of rites per tool

roster.title: Litany: panel Servitors
roster.description: The panel's roster of running and just-finished subagents

sublog.title: Litany: subagent rites
sublog.description: Subagents' tool calls in the panel's rite log, tagged with the agent type

split.title: Litany: split pulse
split.description: The pulse mirrors main-agent rites above the line and subagent rites below it

theme.title: Litany: theme
theme.description: Panel art and colours, and the band's colours

vox.title: Litany: vox
vox.description: A short spoken line after each event, in the theme's voice or one you pick

volumeMaster.title: Litany: master volume
volumeMaster.description: Scales the beeps and the vox together
